author: Inside Edition
description: The glove found by police that appeared to match the glove worn by the kidnapper may have nothing to do with Nancy Guthrie's kidnapping. Inside Edition spoke with Pima County Sheriff Chris Nanos minutes after the news broke. Police helicopters continue to fly low and slow over Tucson in a desperate effort at detecting Guthrie's pacemaker. Inside the chopper is a device known as a signal sniffer that can hone in on a pacemaker transmission.
title: Glove Found May Have Nothing To Do With Nancy Guthrie Kidnapping

author: Inside Edition
description: Tributes are pouring in for Rev. Jesse Jackson, the civil rights leader who passed away at 84. Jackson spent his life fighting racial injustice and was there when Martin Luther King Jr. was assassinated. In 1990, Jackson went to Iraq to free hundreds of American hostages. Inside Edition cameras followed Jackson's trip at the outbreak of the Gulf War. King's eldest son called Jackson "a towering voice and devoted servant of justice."
title: Remembering The Late Rev. Jesse Jackson

author: Inside Edition
description: Heather Mack was found guilty of stuffing her mom's body inside a suitcase while they were on vacation in Bali 12 years ago. Mack was convicted, along with her boyfriend. Now, the boyfriend, Tommy Schaefer, is out of jail after 12 years of imprisonment in Bali. Sheila Von Wiese-Mack had been bludgeoned to death. The arrest of the young lovers caused a sensation in the United States. Journalist Andrea Dixon says she spoke to Heather Mack about the surprise development.
title: Tommy Schaefer, Who Killed Girlfriend's Mom, Released From Bali Prison

author: Inside Edition
description: Inside Edition accompanies former "Real Housewives of Beverly Hills" star Brandi Glanville on the day of her life-saving surgery. She suffered from multiple mystery ailments. Glanville says a recent sonogram revealed what may have been causing her ailments. She had a burst breast implant. Inside Edition was there when Beverly Hills plastic surgeon Dr. Ariel Ourian Marks removed Glanville's old implants and replaced them with new ones. A week after surgery, Glanville said she already felt better.
title: Inside Look At Reality Star Brandi Glanville's Life-Saving Surgery

author: Inside Edition
description: It was a touching reunion at an animal rescue center. Matthew Miller first met this sea lion pup when he was out on his boat with his daughter in San Clemente. He says the little guy practically hitched a ride, knowing he needed help. Miller called animal rescuers, who asked him to bring the pup to a dock so they could pick him up. He was named Chump and veterinarians say they're glad he was found. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Seal Pup Recovering After Hitchhiking A Ride To Shore With Boater

author: Inside Edition
description: An officer arrived at a home to find a 2-month-old baby unable to breathe. It happened in Michigan. The Hamtramck police say a woman met the first responder at the door and handed the child over, hoping for professional help. The officer performed life-saving measures including back blows and then chest compressions. After about 30 seconds, he started hearing the child make noises. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cop Saves 2-Month-Old Baby Who Stopped Breathing

description: Sarah Grace Patrick has pleaded not guilty to all charges. Her trial is scheduled for August 2026.
title: Did Sobbing Teen Murder Her Parents? #shorts
